title: Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Investigating the Truth of the April 16 Sewol Ferry Disaster and Building a Safe Society
title_original: 4ㆍ16세월호참사 진상규명 및 안전사회 건설 등을 위한 특별법 시행령
full_text:
ADDENDA (ORGANIZATION OF THE MINISTRY OF THE INTERIOR AND SAFETY AND ITS AFFILIATED AGENCIES) <Presidential Decree No. 28211, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That amendments to Presidential Decrees pursuant to Article 8 of these Addenda that amend Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the enforcement dates of the respective Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (307) Omitted.
(308) The Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Ascertaining the Truth of the April 16 Sewol Ferry Disaster and Building a Safer Society is partially amended as follows:

In subparagraph 1 of the Notes to attached Table 1, "Office for Government Policy Coordination; four persons (one secretary or technical secretary, one police superintendent, one police senior inspector, and one assistant facilities officer or assistant disaster safety officer) from the Ministry of Public Safety and Security" is replaced with "Office for Government Policy Coordination";
"five persons (two administrative or information systems officers, one administrative or information systems senior officer or records researcher, and two assistant administrative officers or assistant information systems officers) from the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs" is replaced with "seven persons (one secretary or technical secretary, two administrative or information systems officers, one administrative or information systems senior officer or records researcher, and three assistant administrative officers, assistant information systems officers, assistant facilities officers, or assistant disaster safety officers) from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety";
and "National Police Agency" is replaced with "National Police Agency; two persons (one police superintendent and one police senior inspector) from the Korea Coast Guard".

In the Notes to attached Table 2, "Office for Government Policy Coordination; four persons (one secretary or technical secretary, one police superintendent, one police senior inspector, and one assistant facilities officer or assistant disaster safety officer) from the Ministry of Public Safety and Security" is replaced with "Office for Government Policy Coordination";
"five persons (two administrative or information systems officers, one administrative or information systems senior officer or records researcher, and two assistant administrative officers or assistant information systems officers) from the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs" is replaced with "seven persons (one secretary or technical secretary, two administrative or information systems officers, one administrative or information systems senior officer or records researcher, and three assistant administrative officers, assistant information systems officers, assistant facilities officers, or assistant disaster safety officers) from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety";
and "National Police Agency" is replaced with "National Police Agency; two persons (one police superintendent and one police senior inspector) from the Korea Coast Guard".

(309) through (388) Omitted.
